context:
Goal: every log has someone who reads it, or it is not written.
Problem (rule): rule outcomes-mechanize-rules says a log needs a named reader; the reply judge's reader is the advisor, which decides nothing.
Based on (read): docs/decisions/reply-judge-samples-never-refuses.md:8 and hooks/reply_judge.py:31 name "the advisor at each cull" as the reader.
Based on (read): CLAUDE.md rule questions-go-to-owner: the built-in advisor answers no question and decides nothing; docs/decisions/questions-go-to-owner.md:11 retires the terminal advisor session.
Based on (read): no record names who runs the cull.
Departs from: main, with a log read by a role that cannot rule — names a reader, or stops the log.

options.gain: The judge's flags reach the one person who rules whether it stays.
options.how: Name you as the reader, through lint/guard_log_report.py, at each cull. Rewrite the record and the hook comment.
options.label: You read it at each cull
options.lose: One more thing for you to read at a cull.

options.gain: No log without a reader; less to keep.
options.how: Remove the guard.log write from reply_judge.py and the record's reader sentence.
options.label: Stop writing the lines
options.lose: No record of what the judge flagged, so no measure to rule on it later.
